summary: Iteration 2 both-track testing complete. Backend: 11 new iteration-2 pytest cases pass (seller role login creates seller profile + seller_id, buyer role login returns seller_id null, GET /api/users/{phone}, seller reel upload with default poster/video + visible in feed and seller inventory, order placed on seller's reel shows in /api/seller/{sid}/orders, wallet deposit pending flow, admin deposits list, metrics.pending_deposits, approve credits user wallet via $inc, double-approve is idempotent, reject does not credit). Full regression suite: 34/34 pass (fixed outdated `len==6` reels assertion to `>=6` since seeded uploads now add reels). Frontend: role toggle in LoginModal works (role-buyer-btn / role-seller-btn), seller fields (login-district-select / login-village-input) appear conditionally. Seller login lands on SellerDashboard with all 4 tabs; upload flow creates product that immediately appears in inventory. Buyer login shows profile with wallet tab; wallet-deposit-section renders with method selector (bkash shows admin number 01700-123456), amount/sender/trxid inputs; submit shows success toast and the deposit appears in history. Admin panel is NOT reachable from home (home-admin-btn=0) or sidebars (admin-dashboard-link=0); /admin-secret-portal shows password gate; login with admin/Rumpaontu15@ reveals Deposits tab; approving pending deposit succeeds with success toast. BottomNav renders as single instance (previous duplicate testid bug fixed).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `deposit_action` approve path guards on status=='pending' (good; idempotent). Reject path has no such guard — a rejected deposit can be flipped repeatedly between rejected and approved via /action; approve on a previously-rejected deposit will NOT credit (requires status=='pending') so no double-credit risk, but the state machine is loose. Consider restricting transitions.
server.py imports `List` but no longer uses it; minor unused import.

No auth/authorization on /api/admin/* endpoints (only /api/admin/login returns a static token; no middleware verifies it). All admin endpoints are open to anyone who knows the URL. Acceptable for MVP but should be flagged.
/api/reels POST has no auth either — anyone can post reels for any seller_id. For MVP where sellers mock-login this is by design but worth noting.
Login creates a brand-new seller profile every time a new phone registers with role=seller, even if the chosen name/village is garbage. Fine for mock login MVP.
